title: Q4 2026 All-Hands Announcement + Q&A Draft
content:
Purpose - Draft announcement, agenda, and Q&A notes for Redwood Inference Q4 2026 all-hands.
- Goal: communicate Q3 business highlights, product milestones (Dedicated GA launch follow-ups), org changes, and Q4 priorities; prepare leadership talking points and likely employee questions.
High-level outline (30-45 min)
- Intro (5 min): CEO welcome + quick wins
- Product & Tech highlights (10 min): Hosted API metrics, Dedicated capacity GA follow-up, Private deployments status
- Go-to-market / Customers (5 min): top ARR additions, case study mention
- People & Org (5 min): hiring update, new leaders, DEI initiative refresh
- Ops/finance snapshot (5 min): runway + key metrics
- Q&A (10-15 min): live + pre-submitted
Speaker notes / bullets (working)
CEO (Oliver)
- Quick opener: thanks for shipping through a heavy quarter; highlight reliability wins (99.95% SLA on critical routes during peak testing)
- Customer line: "We closed three strategic Dedicated deals this quarter including a major fintech customer (non-sensitive mention)."
- Why Q4 matters: scale Dedicated, ramp Private compliance integrations, continue to reduce per-token cost
Product & Tech (Noah)
- Dedicated: GA follow-up—early customers onprod, performance profiles stable at P50 latency 120ms for short-chat routes; we have a few regression tickets (linked) being triaged
- Hosting catalog: added two Redwood-verified models with quantized variants; Optimize suggestions saved ~22% token cost on pilot workloads
- Private deployments: one enterprise on SOX scope, initial on-prem pilot next week
People Ops (Camila)
- Hiring: we’ll open roles for infra SRE (+2), applied-ml (+1), and devexp (+3). Interview loop updates next week.
- Org changes: product-hosted-api splits into Product AP and Product Console leads (proposal in RFC PR#78)
- Inclusion: remind folks about the November ERG kickoff and psychological safety workshops
Finance (Samira)
- Runway: quarterly burn steady vs plan; committed bookings from Dedicated helped Q3 outlook
- FYI: upcoming budgeting cadence—heads down Nov 1-15 for managers
Slide / visual ideas (notes to self)
- One-slide "what we shipped" with bullets + small metric badges (uptime, cost reduction %, customer count)
- Dedicated adoption funnel: interested -> pilot -> committed (numbers)
- Roadmap lane visual: short-term (next 90 days) vs mid-term (6 months)
Pre-submitted Q&A (compile answers below; mark uncertain items)
Q: Will we open Dedicated to smaller customers / smaller commitments?
A: Short: yes — exploring burst/credits model and smaller pool options; product/commerce will share pilot by EOY. (Action: sync with product-commerce on pilot timeline)
Q: Any layoffs or hiring freezes?
A: No layoffs planned; we’re continuing to hire for prioritized roles but being mindful of spend. (Finance will present high-level runway slide)
Q: Status of Private on-prem roadmap and compliance (SOC2 / SOX)?
A: SOC2 in final docs review; SOX scoping ongoing with one enterprise pilot. Private on-prem packaging: beta customers next month. (Need exact dates from infra/legal)
Q: How are we addressing hallucination / quality regressions when swapping model variants?
A: Product/Applied ML: using eval pipelines + rolling canaries + automatic fallback policies; Optimize now flags regressions against curated prompt sets. (Link eval dashboard in slides)
Open/unresolved items (actionable)
- Get final stats for Hosted API latency and cost improvements (from observability) — assigned: Riley (due: 2026-10-07)
- Confirm Dedicated GA customer count and anonymized logos we can show — assigned: Sales (Oliver) (due: 2026-10-08)
- Legal sign-off on private deployment mention (Camila to ping Legal) — due: 2026-10-09
- Decide whether to include FYI on potential headcount hire freeze if bookings change — talk to Samira
Tone notes (internal)
- Honest about challenges (regressions, support load) but confident and forward-looking.
- Avoid disclosing customer names that are under NDA — coordinate with Sales.
- Keep slides light on text; rely on talk track for nuance.
Logistics / comms plan
- Draft email announcement to employees sent same day after all-hands. Quick summary + links to slides + feedback form. (Camila will draft)
- Record session and put on All-Hands Confluence page with time-stamped notes.
- Collect anonymous feedback (1-2 questions about clarity and priorities)
Next steps (timeline)
- 10/06: Leadership run-through (Oliver, Noah, Samira, Camila)
- 10/08: Slides final + legal review complete
- 10/10: All-hands live (target date; TBD if conflicts)
- 10/10-10/12: Send post-all-hands email + record -> Confluence
Notes to self / scratch (bulleted messy)
- Might want a 1-slide explainer on "how batching/Optimize saved money" using example numbers (before/after)
- Consider a short customer story (no PII) to make impact relatable
- Ask for 2 min at end to remind folks about upcoming internal hackathon and SWAG distribution
- Reminder: follow up with Applied ML for short snippet on kernel selection wins (perf stats)
References / Links (placeholders)
- Draft slides: drive://users/camila-fernandez/q4-all-hands-slides (placeholder)
- Eval dashboard: internal://observability/evals/q3-regression-report
- RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/78
